reviews.review_msg: Dr. Sofo's is an amazing professor. Highly recommend taking his courses for not only your grade but generally interesting material.

Sofos is one of the best and nicest professors I have had in university. He is very kind, approachable, and understanding, and gives extensions when needed. Always helpful in office hours. I took HUM 340 and 347 and enjoyed both. Attend class and put effort into essays and you will do well. Highly recommend.

I highly recommend this prof. I had him for HUM 360 and HUM387 in the same term. His assignments are straightforward and enjoyable as they give you flexibility to relate interests to the course content. He is a bit slow at returning marks. However, his lectures are interesting, very knowledgeable, and he cares about his students.
